slides.texte_overlay:
what people notice about
you in the first 7 seconds

your posture

before you say a single word, people read how you stand. relaxed shoulders and a level chin tell everyone you're comfortable, and that calm spreads quickly.

your curiosity

people notice real curiosity in seconds, and it grows when you feed your mind a little every day. curious people simply seem more alive, and others feel it within seconds.
slides.texte_sophia:
your curiosity

people notice curiosity straight away. i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: a planet, a painting, a moment in history. it shows in how i talk and listen.

slides.texte_overlay:
your eyes

people notice whether you meet their eyes or look away. a warm look held one second longer than usual feels like genuine interest and quietly builds trust.

your pace

people pick up on whether you rush or move calmly. walking and talking a little slower than everyone else reads as quiet, steady confidence almost instantly.

your hands

people notice what your hands are doing. open, relaxed hands look honest and calm, while hidden or fidgeting hands make others feel a little more guarded.
